description: This file defines a syntax highlighting mode for SPARQL queries in the CodeMirror code editor, including tokenization rules and language keywords.

methods.name: wordRegexp
methods.description: Creates a regular expression to match any of the provided words, case-insensitive.

methods.name: tokenBase
methods.description: Tokenizes the base elements of SPARQL syntax, including variables, URIs, literals, operators, and keywords.

methods.name: eatPnLocal
methods.description: Consumes characters for prefixed names in SPARQL syntax.

methods.name: tokenLiteral
methods.description: Handles string literal tokenization, including escape sequences.

methods.name: pushContext
methods.description: Pushes a new parsing context onto the context stack.

methods.name: popContext
methods.description: Pops the current parsing context from the context stack.
